name: The Westin Siray Bay Resort & Spa, Phuket
insider_take: This secluded oceanfront sanctuary sits on pristine Siray Bay, where traditional longtail boats still dock beneath swaying palms—a rare slice of authentic Phuket just minutes from the bustling tourist zones.
whats_special: The resort occupies a prime position on Siray Island's eastern shore, offering unobstructed sunrise views over Phang Nga Bay's limestone karsts. The property features the largest infinity pool in Phuket and showcases contemporary Thai architecture with locally-sourced teak and traditional Baba Peranakan design elements reflecting the island's rich cultural heritage.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view villa for front-row seats to Phuket's most spectacular sunrises, and time your arrival during low tide to explore the nearby mangrove forests on foot.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Heavenly Spa treatment pavilions are built over the water, and the nearby Siray Temple houses a reclining Buddha statue carved from a single piece of white jade. Take the complimentary shuttle to explore Phuket Town's UNESCO-recognized Sino-Portuguese architecture, just 15 minutes away.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Siray Bay with pristine waters
Signature Westin Heavenly Bed and wellness amenities
World-class spa facilities with traditional Thai treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Secluded location may require transportation to reach main attractions
